situation: The application role writes the ledger
given: an Owner, who holds every permission, speaking through ranza_app
when: it inserts a journal entry, a journal line or an account, or updates or deletes a ledger row
then: refused with permission denied: ranza_app holds SELECT on the three ledger tables and no INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE or TRUNCATE at table or column level, so the refusal is the grant and not a missing permission (RANZ-41)
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-01: ranza_app holds SELECT on the ledger tables and no INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE or TRUNCATE, at table or column level; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-01: an Owner speaking through ranza_app cannot insert a journal entry; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-01: an Owner speaking through ranza_app cannot insert a journal line; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-01: an Owner speaking through ranza_app cannot add an account; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-01: ranza_app cannot update a journal entry; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-01: ranza_app cannot delete a journal line; ledger.test.ts: the_application_role_cannot_write_the_ledger_whoever_it_speaks_for

situation: The worker touches a ledger table
given: the ranza_worker role
when: it selects from or inserts into a ledger table, or resolves the finance schema
then: refused: it holds no privilege on any ledger table or sequence and no USAGE on the schema, so the handler reaches the ledger through one function and no table grant (ADR 0027)
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-02: ranza_worker holds no privilege on any ledger table (ADR 0027); platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-02: ranza_app and ranza_worker hold nothing on the ledger sequences; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-02: ranza_worker cannot even resolve the finance schema; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-02: ranza_worker cannot read the ledger; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-02: ranza_worker cannot insert into the ledger directly; ledger.test.ts: the_worker_role_holds_nothing_on_the_ledger_tables

situation: A write policy is left on a ledger table
given: the ledger tables after the grants above are revoked
when: an INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE policy, or any policy naming ranza_worker, remains in the catalogue
then: none remains: a policy with no grant under it reads like a boundary and is not one
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-03: no INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE policy remains on any ledger table; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-03: no ledger policy names ranza_worker

situation: Who may post
given: any role but ranza_worker, PUBLIC included
then: refused: EXECUTE is held by the owner and ranza_worker only, and the posting function is a security definer with an empty search_path (ADR 0027)
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-04: only ranza_worker may execute app.post_folio_line_to_ledger(); platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-04: app.post_folio_line_to_ledger() is a security definer with an empty search_path; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-04: finance.ensure_default_accounts() is executable by neither runtime role nor PUBLIC; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-04: ranza_app cannot execute the posting function; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-04: ranza_app cannot execute ensure_default_accounts

situation: Posting with no worker context
given: ranza_worker with no app.set_worker_context()
then: refused 42501: the function names worker_organization_id() before it reads anything
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-05: the posting function refuses a caller with no worker context

situation: A Folio line is posted
given: a charge, a payment of each method, and a reversal of a charge, of a payment and of a room night
when: the worker posts the event for each
then: one balanced entry per line in the Folio's currency: a charge debits Receivables 1200 and credits Room Revenue 4000 for a room night and Other Revenue 4100 otherwise; a payment debits Cash 1000, Bank 1010 or Card 1020 by method and credits Receivables; a reversal mirrors the line it cancels; the magnitude is read from the signed Folio amount (ADR 0042)
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-06: the worker posts every delivered Folio line; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-06: a charge debits Receivables and credits revenue, a payment debits where it settles, a reversal mirrors the line it cancels; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-06: every posted entry balances

situation: The date of an entry
given: a room night with its own business date, and any other line
then: a room night is dated by its business date and any other line by the business date its Property was working when the line was posted (ADR 0021), never by the day the worker got to it
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-07: a room night is dated by its own business date, in the Folio's currency; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-07: any other line is dated by the business date its Property was working when the line was posted

situation: An event names no line
given: a folio.line_posted event whose payload carries no lineId, which ranza_app may publish for its own Organization
then: the function raises 22023; the dispatcher records last_error and retries on its schedule, leaves the event dead at the attempt cap and writes no delivery row, so it is never marked delivered (the handler used to return quietly and mark it so)
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-08: a folio.line_posted event that names no line is refused loudly, not delivered; ledger.test.ts: an_event_that_names_no_line_is_recorded_and_left_dead_not_delivered

situation: The event or its line does not exist
given: an event id that does not exist, or an event naming a Folio line that does not exist
then: raises P0002 and is recorded as any other failure is
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-09: an event naming a Folio line that does not exist is refused; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-09: an event that does not exist is refused

situation: The wrong kind of event
given: an outbox event that is not folio.line_posted
when: its id is handed to the posting function
then: raises 22023: only a folio.line_posted event is posted to the ledger
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-10: an event of another kind is refused

situation: An event names another Organization's line
given: an event in Organization A naming a Folio line of Organization B
when: the worker, scoped to A, posts it
then: raises P0002: the line is read only within the worker's own Organization, so an event cannot make the worker post another Organization's books
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-11: an event cannot make the worker post another Organization's Folio line

situation: The worker is scoped to another Organization
given: an event of Organization A and a worker context set for Organization B
then: raises 42501: the event belongs to another Organization
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-12: the worker cannot post an event that belongs to an Organization it is not scoped to

situation: A payload that lies
given: an event whose payload names a real line but claims another type, amount, payment method and currency, as ranza_app may write it (events_publish_own_scope)
then: the entry is the Folio line's own: amount, accounts and currency come from folio_lines, which is append-only, never from the payload; otherwise any member could forge the books through the queue the ledger grants no longer allow directly
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-13: an event whose payload lies about its line still posts, as the line; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-13: a forged payload cannot change the amount, the accounts or the currency posted: the Folio line decides

situation: The same line twice
given: a redelivery, a rival worker, or a forged event followed by the genuine one, all naming one Folio line
then: exactly one entry exists per Folio line and every later call returns it rather than failing, by unique (organization_id, source_type, source_id) and on conflict do nothing
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-14: posting the same event again returns the entry that exists; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-14: one entry per Folio line posted; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-14: the genuine event for a line a forged event already posted finds that entry; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-14: a line is posted once however many events name it

situation: The commit-time checks run as the worker
given: the balance and two-line checks are deferred to COMMIT and run as whoever commits
when: the worker, which holds nothing on the ledger tables, commits a posting
then: the checks are security definers, run as their owner, and pass; as invokers they failed every posting at commit with permission denied once the worker's grants were revoked
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-15: the two commit-time checks run as their owner, because the worker that commits holds no read on the tables they read; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-15: the deferred balance and two-line checks pass when the worker is the one committing

situation: An unbalanced entry
given: an entry whose debits differ from its credits
then: refused 23514 by the deferred balance trigger, however it was written
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-16: unbalanced entry is refused by balance check trigger

situation: An entry with fewer than two lines
given: a journal entry header with no or one line
then: refused 23514 by the deferred two-line trigger
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-17: a journal entry without at least two lines is refused by deferred trigger

situation: An account of another Organization
given: a journal line naming an account of a different Organization than its entry
then: refused 23503 by the composite foreign key on (organization_id, account_id)
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-18: referencing another organization account is refused by composite foreign key

situation: The same source or line number twice
given: an entry for a source that already has one, or a second line with an existing line number on an entry
then: refused 23505 by the unique constraints
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-19: re-posting the same source record is refused by unique constraint; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-19: duplicate line_number on journal entry is refused by unique constraint

situation: Rewriting the books
given: a journal entry or line that exists
when: anyone, the table owner included, updates, deletes or truncates it
then: refused 42501 by the append-only triggers; a correction is a reversing entry, never an edit (blueprint 7.4)
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-20: updating a journal entry is refused by append-only trigger; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-20: deleting a journal entry is refused by append-only trigger; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-20: truncating journal lines is refused by append-only trigger; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-20: truncating journal entries is refused by append-only trigger

situation: A lapsed Subscription and the books
given: an Organization whose Subscription is suspended, and a Folio line written before it lapsed
when: the worker delivers the line's event
then: the entry is still posted: this is the bookkeeping of a fact that already happened, so no commercial gate stands in front of it (ADR 0040)
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S1-21: a suspended Subscription does not stop a Folio line reaching the ledger

situation: A Folio line reaches the ledger without being re-entered
given: a Property that does billing and a checked-in Guest
when: the front desk posts a charge, a payment and their reversals through the Folios module
then: the dispatcher running as ranza_worker posts each through the one function and a member holding finance.view_ledger reads the entries back, with Receivables netting to zero; nobody re-enters anything and redelivery changes nothing (RANZ-41 done-when)
test_name: ledger.test.ts: a Folio line reaches the ledger without being re-entered anywhere

situation: The permission and who ships with it
given: the permission catalogue and the shipped roles
when: finance.view_ledger is looked up and the shipped roles are read
then: it is in the catalogue under billing_folios and is held by Owner, Manager and Finance, and not by Front desk or Housekeeping; a custom role holds it only if its Organization composes it (ADR 0026)
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S2-01: finance.view_ledger is in the catalogue under billing_folios; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S2-01: Owner, Manager and Finance hold finance.view_ledger; Front desk and Housekeeping do not

situation: The read policies carry every gate
given: the three read policies on the ledger tables
when: their text is read from the catalogue
then: each asks membership, whole-Organization reach, finance.view_ledger and the Folio finance capability, in the policy and not beside it (ADR 0012)
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S2-02: all three read policies ask membership, whole-Organization reach, finance.view_ledger and the Folio finance capability

situation: A permitted reader reads
given: an Owner, a Finance member with whole-Organization reach, or a member of a role the Organization wrote holding only finance.view_ledger, with an active Subscription and Folio finance on
when: they read journal entries, journal lines or the chart of accounts
then: they read their own Organization's rows and only those
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S2-03: an Owner reads the Organization's entries; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S2-03: an Owner reads the Organization's journal lines; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S2-03: an Owner reads the chart of accounts, and only their own Organization's; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S2-03: a Finance member with whole-Organization reach reads the ledger; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S2-03: an Organization's own role holding only finance.view_ledger reads the ledger: the permission is composable

situation: A member without the permission
given: a Front desk or Housekeeping member with whole-Organization reach, in an Organization whose Subscription and capability both admit them
when: they read journal entries, lines or accounts
then: they read nothing: reach and subscription admit them and only the permission denies, so a housekeeper no longer reads every journal entry
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S2-04: a Front desk member reads no journal entry, though reach and subscription both admit them; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S2-04: a Front desk member reads no journal line; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S2-04: a Front desk member reads no account; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S2-04: a Housekeeping member reads no journal entry; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S2-04: a Housekeeping member reads no journal line; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S2-04: a Housekeeping member reads no account

situation: A Finance member assigned to one Property
given: a Finance member whose access scope is assigned_properties, holding finance.view_ledger
then: they read nothing: an entry carries no Property (blueprint 9.8), so the only honest reach is the whole Organization, as ADR 0031 decides for an audit record with no location; narrowing is ACC-DEF-01. Owner to confirm: the shipped Finance role reads the ledger only when it is organization_wide
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S2-05: a Finance member assigned to one Property reads nothing, because an entry has no Property to narrow to

situation: Another Organization
given: an Owner of Organization B, whose own ledger has one entry
then: they read their own single entry and none of Organization A's entries, lines or accounts
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S2-06: another Organization's Owner reads their own single entry and none of the 11 beside it; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S2-06: another Organization's Owner reads none of this Organization's journal lines; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S2-06: another Organization's Owner reads none of this Organization's accounts

situation: A suspended or cancelled Subscription
given: an Owner who read the ledger a moment ago, and an Organization whose Subscription is now suspended
when: they read journal entries or lines
then: they read nothing: gate 1 of blueprint 3.5 denies
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S2-07: an Owner whose Subscription is suspended reads no journal entry; platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S2-07: a suspended Subscription denies the journal lines too

situation: A past_due Subscription
given: an Organization whose Subscription is past_due
then: they read it: past_due is the grace period (ADR 0040)
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S2-08: a past_due Subscription is a grace period and still reads the ledger (ADR 0040)

situation: Folio finance switched off
given: an Organization that has switched the Folio finance capability off at its only Property
then: they read nothing: the commercial gate asks the capability that feeds the ledger, since no accounting capability exists (ACC-DEF-02)
test_name: platform_finance.test.sql: ACC-S2-09: an Organization that has switched Folio finance off reads no journal entry

situation: A housekeeper reads through the module
given: an entry posted from a Folio line, a Manager and a Housekeeping member of the same Organization
when: each reads the entry through the finance module
then: the Manager reads it and the Housekeeping member gets null
test_name: ledger.test.ts: a_member_without_finance_view_ledger_reads_no_entry_of_their_own_organization

situation: Accounting periods and a controlled close
given: an Organization that wants to lock a month
then: deferred: blueprint 5.10 asks for periods and controlled close; nothing is built, so an entry can be posted to any date and the ledger has no closed month

situation: Financial statements
given: a ledger with posted entries
when: somebody asks for a trial balance, an income statement or a balance sheet
then: deferred: only account balances by currency exist as a read (getAccountBalancesWithin); the statements are blueprint 5.10 and need periods first (ACC-NB-01)

situation: A ledger screen
given: a member holding finance.view_ledger
when: they look for the ledger in the Operator Workspace
then: deferred: there is no screen; the read policies, the permission and the module reads are in place for one, which owes the back button of ADR 0035 and en, tr and ar copy

situation: A Property-scoped read of the ledger
given: a Finance member assigned to one Property
then: deferred: entries carry no location, so the read is Organization-wide or nothing (ACC-S2-05); narrowing means a nullable location_id on the entry and host functions in the shape of ADR 0031, and is a decision

situation: An Accounting Entitlement of its own
given: an Organization that buys Accounting separately from Billing and Folios
then: deferred: finance.view_ledger sits under billing_folios and the read gate asks the Folio finance capability, because no accounting module key or capability exists; a sold module takes its own key in its own migration (blueprint 3.3)

situation: Maintaining the chart of accounts
given: an Organization that wants another account or to retire one
then: deferred: ensure_default_accounts() writes the standard six and no runtime role can write accounts; editing the chart needs its own permission, policy and column grants

situation: Other sources reaching the ledger
given: a payroll run approved (payroll.approved) or a maintenance charge
then: deferred: payroll.approved is published and nothing consumes it; a second source follows the shape of app.post_folio_line_to_ledger(): the worker names the event and a definer derives the posting from the source row

situation: Reading the books after a Subscription ends
given: an Organization whose Subscription is suspended or cancelled
when: its Owner wants its financial history
then: deferred: ACC-S2-07 denies the read as the brief asks; a read-only path for history is the new decision ADR 0040 names for when reporting exists

situation: An audit record for a posting
given: the worker posts an entry
then: deferred: no audit record is written; the entry is append-only, carries its source and is dated, and the Folio command that produced the line is itself audited. Owner to confirm that is enough

situation: Posting inside the Folio's own transaction
given: a screen that must show a posting the instant a line is written
then: deferred: ADR 0042 allowed a synchronous post; ranza_app cannot write the ledger, so posting is asynchronous through the outbox (ADR 0020)
